verses.text: For the music director. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. I said, "I will be careful about how I live, so I do not sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth shut, as if with a muzzle, while wicked people are around me."
So I was silent and said nothing, not even anything good. But my pain grew worse.
My heart grew hot inside me. As I thought about it, the fire burned. Then I spoke out:
"LORD, show me when my life will end and how many days I have. Let me know how short my life is.
You have made my days only a few hands wide. My whole lifetime is like nothing to you. Every person is only a breath." Selah.
"Each person walks around like a shadow. They rush around for nothing. They pile up wealth, not knowing who will get it.
So, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Rescue me from all my sins. Do not let foolish people make fun of me.
I was silent. I did not open my mouth, because you are the one who did this.
Stop hitting me. I am worn out by the blows from your hand.
When you correct people for their sins, you eat away their wealth like a moth. Every person is only a breath." Selah.
"LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for help. Do not ignore my tears. I am a visitor with you, a foreigner, just as all my ancestors were.
Look away from me so I can be happy again before I leave and am gone."
